basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Texas at Austin Graduate School Fellowships & GRA/GTA Packages
basic_details.offering_entity: The Graduate School & Cockrell School of Engineering, University of Texas at Austin
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Texas at Austin (Austin, Texas, USA)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Department of Computer Science, Chandra Family Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE), Walker Department of Mechanical Engineering, Department of Aerospace Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Physics, and Mathematics.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100% of admitted research doctoral students receive full multi-year funding guarantees (~500 to 650 doctoral awards annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally on merit; Pakistani scholars in computing, software engineering, and chip design regularly secure full UT Austin doctoral funding (~5 to 10 awards annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full 5 years of doctoral study guaranteed
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: $35,000 to $40,000 / year (approx. $2,910 to $3,330 / month; ~PKR 810,000 to 925,000 / month) 12-month living stipend plus 100% full tuition reduction benefit and comprehensive UT employee health insurance

nationality_requirements: Open to international students worldwide including Pakistan as well as U.S. citizens/PR
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction; selection based strictly on academic excellence and research potential.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's or 18-year Master's degree with exceptional academic standing (equivalent to minimum GPA 3.75+ / 4.00 or top-decile rank) from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum undergraduate/graduate GPA of 3.75 / 4.0; admitted UT Austin doctoral candidates are evaluated on research impact.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, mechanical engineering, aerospace, physics, or related quantitative field.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year undergraduate/master's students completing degree before September.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior scientific research publications, conference presentations, or industrial software contributions strongly advantageous.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: TOEFL iBT minimum 80 or IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 mandatory for UT Austin Graduate School (higher scores recommended for assistantship eligibility).
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must be admitted to a University of Texas at Austin PhD program.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Coordinated with UT Austin standard multi-year doctoral funding guarantee.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition covered through Tuition Reduction Benefit (TRB) covering out-of-state/international tuition and university fees.

admission_application_fee.details: UT Austin graduate application fee of $90; fee waivers available for eligible applicants.

accommodation.details: University graduate apartments (Gateway, Colorado) or private rental apartments in North Campus, Hyde Park, or Riverside funded comfortably via monthly living stipend.
accommodation.amount: Funded from stipend (~$850 to $1,350 / month rent in Austin)

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed 12-month living stipend of $35,000 to $40,000 / year ($2,910 to $3,330 / month; ~PKR 810,000 to 925,000 / month) disbursed semimonthly.

airfare.details: Relocation flights to Austin are self-funded or subsidized by departmental relocation allowances.

visa_fee.details: U.S. F-1 Student Visa application fee (~$185) and SEVIS I-901 fee (~$350) paid to U.S. government.

health_insurance.details: AcademicBlue Student Health Plan / UT Select Employee Health Insurance 100% covered for graduate student academic employees (GRA/TA).

food_allowance.details: Dining and groceries covered through monthly living allowance.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: UT Austin Libraries (Perry-Castañeda Library), Texas Advanced Computing Center (TACC - home to Frontera supercomputer), and laboratory infrastructure included.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Graduate School Professional Development Awards provide up to $1,000 to $2,000 per year for presenting research papers at conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Capital Metro (CapMetro) bus and MetroRail system is 100% free of charge for all UT Austin students with valid student ID.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single world-leading engineering and computing powerhouse (University of Texas at Austin).
participating_institutions: University of Texas at Austin (Main Campus, Austin, Texas, USA)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: CSRankings Top 8 globally for Computer Science, AI, Systems, and Architecture; U.S. News #7 nationally in Engineering and Computer Science; world leader in Semiconductor Technology, VLSI, and Supercomputing.
available_majors: PhD in Computer Science (Systems, AI, Theory, Architecture)
PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE / Chip Design / AI)
PhD in Operations Research and Industrial Engineering
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 5 years of full-time doctoral study and research
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree with 3.75+ GPA, verified transcripts, TOEFL 80+ or IELTS 6.5+, three academic letters of recommendation, CV detailing research outputs, and statement of purpose.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: UT Austin Computer Science and ECE are intensely competitive (acceptance rate ~7%); demonstrating prior peer-reviewed research publications or strong technical contributions is crucial.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Articulate clear research synergy with specific UT Austin faculty research groups and centers (e.g., Texas Advanced Computing Center - TACC, Center for Perceptual Systems, Microelectronics Research Center).

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: ApplyTexas / UT Austin Graduate Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the UT Austin application portal, choose target PhD department, select faculty of interest, upload transcripts, statement of purpose, CV, test scores, and register 3 referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore UT Austin faculty profiles and published papers in your field of interest.
Step 2: Obtain valid TOEFL iBT (80+) or IELTS Academic (6.5+) score report.
Step 3: Submit PhD application on UT Austin portal by December 15 deadline.
Step 4: Upload official academic transcripts, statement of purpose, and curriculum vitae.
Step 5: Three academic referees submit letters directly into the UT Austin system.
Step 6: Departmental faculty admissions committee reviews applications and selects doctoral candidates.
Step 7: Successful applicants receive formal admission offer with full 5-year guaranteed funding package in February/March.
Step 8: Accept offer by April 15, receive I-20, and apply for U.S. F-1 Student Visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Universal Doctoral Funding: 100% of admitted UT Austin engineering and computing PhD students receive full multi-year GRA/GTA funding guarantees without separate financial aid application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via automated secure electronic appraisal forms.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose (approx. 1,000 words) describing academic trajectory, research questions, proposed methodologies, and alignment with UT Austin faculty.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Incorporated into statement of purpose; publications or thesis samples uploaded under supplementary materials.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic research CV detailing education, publications, conference presentations, awards, and technical proficiencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Virtual technical interviews via Zoom with prospective faculty advisors evaluating research depth and theoretical foundation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT 80+ or IELTS 6.5+ mandatory; GRE optional/department-specific.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: $90 (approx. PKR 25,000; fee waiver available upon request)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Official HEC verified transcripts required upon final matriculation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation of all non-English transcripts.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online submission via UT Austin application portal.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual admission cycle for Fall semester entry; applications strictly due by mid-December.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 25% (Academic GPA, transcript rigor, foundational coursework grades)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 50% (Demonstrated research originality, peer-reviewed publications, technical problem solving)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Industry R&D lab experience or software engineering)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Faculty Admissions Committees and Department Chairs.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic review prioritizing research depth, originality, peer-reviewed outputs, and scientific match with UT Austin research laboratories.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~5,000 to 6,500 doctoral applicants across engineering and computing colleges
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~100% of admitted PhD students receive full multi-year funding guarantees
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~3.5% to 6.0% for extraordinary applicants with peer-reviewed publications and near-perfect GPAs
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate GPA >= 3.80 / 4.00, typically with 1 to 3 peer-reviewed publications in reputable international venues
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Scholars holding bachelor's or research master's degrees with exceptional quantitative skills, peer-reviewed publications, and compelling research visions.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from premier Pakistani universities (NUST, LUMS, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, PIEAS, UET) and international graduate programs.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official University of Texas at Austin website at utexas.edu.
UT Austin never works with commercial recruiting agencies.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of $90 is paid directly through the secure portal; fee waivers are available for eligible applicants.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agencies cannot influence UT Austin admissions; fraudulent applications result in permanent bans.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IELTS or TOEFL test fees: ~PKR 55,000 to 65,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: UT Austin doctoral students must pay tuition. Reality: 100% of admitted UT Austin engineering and computing doctoral students receive full tuition coverage, health insurance, and a generous 12-month living stipend ($35k-$40k/yr).
Myth: You need a master's degree to apply. Reality: Students holding a 4-year Bachelor's degree are directly eligible to apply to UT Austin PhD programs.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites frequently quote outdated stipend values; current verified UT Austin 12-month doctoral stipend is $35,000 to $40,000.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic progress and minimum B (3.0/4.0) average in graduate coursework.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time resident study in Austin and active contribution to research laboratory projects.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews and doctoral qualifying exams administered by the department.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Graduate Research Assistant (GRA) or Graduate Teaching Assistant (GTA) duties are integrated into doctoral training; outside employment is restricted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates are eligible for 3-year U.S. STEM OPT work authorization.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligation to fulfill designated departmental research or teaching duties.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminated if student withdraws or fails academic milestones.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from graduate program committee and faculty supervisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Full guaranteed funding for 5 years; dissertation completion support available for year 6.
